title: stack-of-tasks/tsid official implementation
summary: Pinned official TSID solver mapped to inverse-dynamics problem assembly, motion tasks, rigid contacts, SE(3) tasks, and actuation bounds; it does not contain the complete paper-specific actuator-identification pipeline.

metadata.scope_caveat: Implementation evidence covers the TSID optimization layer, not a complete reproduction of motor identification and torque estimation.
metadata.redistribution: No external code, configuration, model, or robot asset is copied into the handbook.
